note: Curated by measurement, not by ear: each pack member was mapped to an effect type by its Kenney file name, decoded at 48 kHz (mono), and measured (soundkit.measure). Rejected: a decoded peak at or over full scale (clipped), over 150 ms of silence before it or 300 ms after it, more than one event, a floor within 12 dB of its loudest over 0.1 s (steady noise), a peak under -20 dBFS. Each type's default ("default": true) has a crisp attack (30 ms or less, except moves and builds) and is the closest to the synth voice of that type in brightness and length; facts.contact and facts.samples are at 48 kHz. facts.trim_db is the gain that brings a sound to the level of the synth voice of its type (soundkit.trim: the K-weighted loudest 10 ms, soundkit.level; a type only the kit has goes to the synth voices' median), since Kenney normalises its files near -1 dBFS.
